inherits.formula: schema_v16.json, schema_v15.json, and their transitive source contract
inherits.meaning: no inherited mathematical constraint is removed or weakened

equality_closure_prefilter.relations: true global-K4, active critical-row, and rich-row bits equate their undirected distance edges
equality_closure_prefilter.contradiction: an active critical or rich false bit is connected to a true member of its own exact row
equality_closure_prefilter.explanation: the blocker contains every concrete true/false/activation fix used by a shortest equality path
equality_closure_prefilter.admission: every generalized explanation must replay UNSAT in a fresh plain z3.Solver containing the frozen raw full formula

fixed_assignment_normalization.scope: only after every semantic Bool has a fixed value
fixed_assignment_normalization.trackers: the exact 26-name source-tracker allowlist is verified and substituted true; an assumption-core variant is optional diagnostic work and is not blocker-bearing
fixed_assignment_normalization.pb_rewrite: the observed weighted PbGe shape is exactly decomposed to cardinality plus Boolean structure, then card2bv exactly eliminates every cardinality node
fixed_assignment_normalization.audit: reject unless all post-transform sorts and operations are quantifier-free Bool plus linear Real arithmetic, with zero PB, If, Int, BV, Array, nonlinear, or nonconstant-UF nodes
fixed_assignment_normalization.solver: SolverFor(QF_LRA), one thread, fixed seed and bounded timeout

blocker_admission.generalized: only equality-closure explanations authenticated by fresh raw-full-formula replay
blocker_admission.theory_unsat: only the exact 825-literal complete semantic assignment, after fresh-context reconstruction of the frozen formula, independent normalization, fresh QF_LRA audit, and fresh UNSAT check; the replay record is self-contained with explicit status, logic audit, fixed/raw PB counts, and raw/source/reconstructed/universe/assignment/blocker hashes
blocker_admission.assignment_identity: canonical assignment SHA-256 must be unchanged at replay
blocker_admission.tracker_core: the attempted assumption-core variant timed out and is not used; decisive primary and replay checks record exact allowlist substitution instead
blocker_admission.sat: terminal only after the normalized model evaluates every original frozen assertion to true

records: v17 and transitive v16 through v8 source/schema hashes plus uv.lock, focused-test source hash, retained focused-test log hash, and test command
Z3 version, seed, one-thread setting, and budgets
frozen raw, Boolean-master, assignment, normalized-formula, tracker-core, replay, blocker, and cumulative hashes
pre/post PB counts, exact logic audits, and per-phase timings
Boolean-master and frozen gzip blob hashes in result.json; result.json hash in enclosing summary.json
provenance.result_self_hash: not embedded because adding that hash changes result.json; summary.json attests the finalized result.json bytes

terminal_status.process_exit: nonzero when the requested case is incomplete

trust_boundary: external Z3 evidence for the exact-n15 finite encoding; not a Lean theorem, kernel certificate, or universal closure result
